title: Rework Paid-Rental Days and Rental Vehicle Coordination History: Training Notes
content:
Under the Workmanship Warranties, rework paid-rental days are added to the rework courtesy rental days on a covered network rework. The rework paid-rental days follow the rental days the customer paid as uncovered days on the customer's network rentals under Rental Vehicle Coordination: the long paid-rental days, 10, or more, the long paid-rental extra days, 2 days; at least one but fewer than 10, the short paid-rental extra days, 1 day; none, no rework paid-rental days.

## Training questions

Q. Which rental days are counted?
A. The uncovered days charged to the customer on the money history of the customer's Rental Vehicle Coordination rentals, added together across all of the customer's rentals.

Q. Are days covered by an insurer or by the network counted?
A. No. Only rental days the customer paid as uncovered days.

Q. What does each total give?

| Uncovered rental days the customer paid, all rentals together | Rework paid-rental days |
|---|---|
| none | none |
| 1 to 9 | 1 day |
| 10 or more | 2 days |

## Hypothetical illustration

A customer was charged 4 uncovered days on one rental and 6 uncovered days on a later rental: 10 days in all, so 2 days are added. Had the later rental carried 5 uncovered days, the total of 9 days would add 1 day.
